name: KeeneticOS MT7621 TeleMT MIPSel pinned IPK opkg install, local Core run, native reboot and rc.unslung autostart

steps.send: show version
show running-config
/opt/bin/opkg print-architecture
/opt/bin/opkg list-installed
/opt/bin/opkg install bash
/opt/bin/bash --version
/opt/bin/busybox test ! -e /opt/etc/init.d/doinstall && printf 'DOINSTALL_%s\n' ABSENT
printf MARK$((7*6)) > /opt/.lab-marker; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/.lab-marker
/opt/bin/busybox cat /proc/mounts
/opt/bin/opkg print-architecture
/opt/bin/bash --version
/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/.lab-marker

/opt/bin/busybox --list | /opt/bin/busybox grep -x base64 >/dev/null && /opt/bin/busybox --list | /opt/bin/busybox grep -x readlink >/dev/null && /opt/bin/busybox --list | /opt/bin/busybox grep -x wget >/dev/null && /opt/bin/busybox --list | /opt/bin/busybox grep -x sha256sum >/dev/null && printf 'APPLET_%s\n' READY

mkdir -p /opt/etc/init.d /opt/lab /opt/var/run /opt/var/log && printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab && printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml && printf '%s' 'dGVsZW10LWxhYi1zeW50aGV0aWMtc2VjcmV0LTAwMDE=' | base64 -d > /opt/etc/telemt-lab.secret && printf '%s' 'W2Jyb2tlbi10b21sLXRhYmxlCg==' | base64 -d > /opt/lab/broken-telemt.toml && chmod 700 /opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab && chmod 600 /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml /opt/etc/telemt-lab.secret /opt/lab/broken-telemt.toml && [ "$(/opt/bin/busybox wc -c < /opt/etc/telemt-lab.secret | /opt/bin/busybox tr -d ' ')" -ge 32 ] && test -x /opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab && printf 'TELEMT_%s\n' FILES_READY

/opt/bin/busybox wget -qO /opt/lab/telemt.ipk http://192.168.1.100/entware/telemt_3.5.17-2fb1_mipsel-3.4.ipk && /opt/bin/busybox wget -qO /opt/lab/telemt-panel.ipk http://192.168.1.100/entware/telemt-panel-lite_1.0.0.rc.4-1_mipsel-3.4.ipk && printf '%s  %s\n' '2c8a84fb93535303eeb4bb8a0a5057370f4e625b1cdf0e102f04e33e28c85d8d' telemt.ipk '0236dfb076b14b129a6392de49f287838a11aebe7681e092084d4ce87e771e68' telemt-panel.ipk > /opt/lab/expected.sha && cd /opt/lab && /opt/bin/busybox sha256sum -c expected.sha >/dev/null && printf 'IPKS_%s\n' DELIVERED
/opt/bin/opkg install /opt/lab/telemt.ipk >/opt/lab/opkg-core.log 2>&1 && /opt/bin/opkg status telemt | /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'Version: 3.5.17-2fb1' && printf 'OPKG_%s\n' CORE_OK

/opt/bin/opkg install /opt/lab/telemt-panel.ipk >/opt/lab/opkg-panel.log 2>&1 && /opt/bin/opkg status telemt-panel-lite | /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'Version: 1.0.0~rc.4-1' && printf 'OPKG_%s\n' PANEL_OK

printf '%s  %s\n' 'd4ba43815883dd1ce9aa57349602598127781e8966d51dab97616dbdb35b216f' /opt/bin/telemt '380cb5112b58538eafec9ae9fab27fb22c994fd36ce3130c541c5e11b29a40c8' /opt/bin/telemt-panel > /opt/lab/elf.sha && cd / && /opt/bin/busybox sha256sum -c /opt/lab/elf.sha >/dev/null && test -x /opt/bin/telemt && test -x /opt/bin/telemt-panel && printf 'BINARIES_%s\n' PINNED
HOME=/opt/lab TMPDIR=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode=lab-probe-invalid >/opt/lab/cli.out 2>/opt/lab/cli.err; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 2 ] && printf 'CLI_%s\n' REJECTED || exit 1
/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/lab/cli.err

HOME=/opt/lab TMPDIR=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt run /opt/lab/broken-telemt.toml >/opt/lab/toml.out 2>/opt/lab/toml.err; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 1 ] && /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'unclosed table' /opt/lab/toml.err && ! /opt/bin/busybox grep -qi 'panicked' /opt/lab/toml.err && printf 'TOML_%s\n' REJECTED || exit 1

cd /opt/lab && /opt/bin/busybox wget -qO /opt/lab/probe-entware http://192.168.1.100/entware/probe-entware && chmod 755 /opt/lab/probe-entware && /opt/lab/probe-entware > /opt/lab/probe.out 2>&1; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/lab/probe.out; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/lab/probe.out > /dev/console 2>/dev/null; /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'PROBE_GLIBC_SYMBOL_RET_-1_ERRNO_89' /opt/lab/probe.out && /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'PROBE_LIBC_GETRANDOM_RET_32_ERRNO_0' /opt/lab/probe.out && /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'PROBE_RAW_SYSCALL_RET_32_ERRNO_0' /opt/lab/probe.out && /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'PROBE_URANDOM_READ_OK' /opt/lab/probe.out && /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'PROBE_DEVRANDOM_POLLIN_READY' /opt/lab/probe.out && printf 'PROBE_KERNEL_%s\n' FACT_OK

cd /opt/etc; rm -f /opt/var/run/telemt-diag.pid; HOME=/opt/lab TMPDIR=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt start --foreground --pid-file /opt/var/run/telemt-diag.pid /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml > /opt/lab/telemt-fg.log 2>&1 & fgp=$!; i=0; alive=1; while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do kill -0 $fgp 2>/dev/null || { alive=0; break; }; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; if [ "$alive" = 1 ]; then kill $fgp 2>/dev/null; printf 'FG_%s
' ALIVE_20S; else wait $fgp; printf 'FG_%s
' EXITED; fi; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/lab/telemt-fg.log; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/lab/telemt-fg.log > /dev/console 2>/dev/null; printf 'DIAG_%s
' CAPTURED

rm -f /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid; HOME=/opt/lab TMPDIR=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt start --log-file /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log --pid-file /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml; if [ $? = 0 ]; then printf 'TELEMT_%s\n' STARTED; else /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log > /dev/console 2>/dev/null; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi
/opt/bin/busybox sleep 3; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log 2>/dev/null; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log > /dev/console 2>/dev/null; printf 'LOG_%s\n' EMITTED

pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then printf 'DAEMON_%s\n' PROC_ALIVE; else /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log > /dev/console 2>/dev/null; /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/log/telemt-lab.log 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi

ok=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do if HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode liveness /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && printf 'HEALTH_%s\n' 'LIVE' || exit 1

pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid); cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '�' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null); exe=$(/opt/bin/busybox readlink /proc/$pid/exe 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *telemt*) [ "$exe" = /opt/bin/telemt ] && printf 'PID_%s\n' 'ALIVE' || exit 1;; *) exit 1;; esac

/opt/bin/busybox grep -Eq '0100007F:2383 +[0-9A-F]{8}:[0-9A-F]{4} +0A ' /proc/net/tcp && /opt/bin/busybox grep -Eq '(0100007F|00000000):0D6B +[0-9A-F]{8}:[0-9A-F]{4} +0A ' /proc/net/tcp && printf 'SOCKETS_%s\n' LISTENING

/opt/bin/busybox sleep 10 && HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode liveness /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml >/dev/null 2>&1 && pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid) && [ -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ] && printf 'STABLE_%s\n' AFTER_10S

HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt stop --pid-file /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid >/dev/null 2>&1; ok=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ ! -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then ok=1; break; fi; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && printf 'TELEMT_%s\n' 'STOPPED' || exit 1
HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode liveness /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1 || printf 'HEALTH_%s\n' DOWN_AFTER_STOP
out=$(/opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab start) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" && /opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid > /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid1

ok=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do if HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode liveness /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && printf 'RESTART_HEALTH_%s\n' 'OK' || exit 1

/opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab stop; ok=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ ! -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then ok=1; break; fi; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && printf 'TELEMT_OFF_%s\n' 'PREBOOT' || exit 1
/opt/bin/busybox cat /proc/mounts

ok=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do if HOME=/opt/lab /opt/bin/telemt healthcheck --mode liveness /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi; /opt/bin/busybox sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && printf 'AUTOSTART_HEALTH_%s\n' 'OK' || exit 1

pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid); cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '�' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null); exe=$(/opt/bin/busybox readlink /proc/$pid/exe 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *telemt*) [ "$exe" = /opt/bin/telemt ] && printf 'AUTOSTART_PID_%s\n' 'ALIVE' || exit 1;; *) exit 1;; esac

n=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"/opt/etc/telemt-lab.""toml"*) n=$((n+1));; esac; done; [ "$n" = 1 ] && printf 'AUTOSTART_%s\n' SINGLE || exit 1

/opt/bin/opkg status telemt | /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'Version: 3.5.17-2fb1' && /opt/bin/opkg status telemt-panel-lite | /opt/bin/busybox grep -q 'Version: 1.0.0~rc.4-1' && test -r /opt/etc/telemt-lab.toml && test -x /opt/etc/init.d/S99telemtlab && test -r /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.gen && printf 'PERSISTED_%s\n' FILES
[ "$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.gen)" = 2 ] && printf 'GEN_%s\n' TWO || exit 1
printf 'PIDS %s %s\n' "$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid1 2>/dev/null)" "$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/telemt-lab.pid 2>/dev/null)"
cd / && /opt/bin/busybox sync && printf 'SYNC_%s\n' COMPLETE
